settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Control how the app behaves, protects and looks.
settings.general.startMinimizedHint: Open in the background without showing the window.
settings.general.lockOnMinimizeHint: Lock the application as soon as the window is minimized.
settings.general.rememberWindowSizeHint: Restore the window size and position on the next start.
settings.autoLockHint: Lock the application and all vaults after a period without activity.
settings.backgroundLockHint: Lock after the window has been in the background for this long.
settings.lockOnSessionLockHint: Lock the application when you lock your Windows session.
settings.lockOnSleepHint: Lock the application when the computer goes to sleep.
settings.panic.title: Panic lock shortcut
settings.panic.hint: Locks the application and every vault instantly, even when the window is hidden.
settings.requireMasterSensitive: Ask for the master password for sensitive actions
settings.requireMasterSensitiveHint: Required before changing passwords, removing recovery keys or deleting vaults.
settings.requireMasterReveal: Ask for the master password to reveal passwords
settings.requireMasterRevealHint: Required each time a saved password is shown or copied.
settings.master.title: Master password
settings.master.hint: Protects your Password Vault, saved passwords and Default Encryption Password.
settings.master.warning: The master password cannot be recovered. If you forget it, saved passwords are lost.
settings.postEncryptHint: What happens to the original file once the protected copy is verified.
settings.defaultModeHint: How the Default Encryption Password is offered when protecting items.
settings.generator.title: Password generator
settings.clipboardHint: Copied passwords are cleared from the clipboard after this time, only if it still holds that password.
settings.themeHint: Dark uses a true black base. System follows Windows.
settings.languageHint: Switches instantly, including the reading direction.
settings.win.autostartHint: Adds a per-user startup entry. No administrator rights are needed.
settings.win.contextMenuHint: Adds Protect and Unlock commands to the right-click menu.
settings.win.fileAssocHint: Lets you open protected files with a double-click.
settings.win.unsupported: Windows integration is not available on this system.
settings.win.uninstallNote: Uninstalling removes these entries. Your protected files are never deleted.
settings.privacy.local: Everything stays on this computer. The app makes no network connections and sends no telemetry.

settings.privacy.reset.body: Removes the master password, saved passwords, vault list and settings. Your protected files on disk are not deleted.
settings.privacy.reset.confirmBody: Reset the application? Saved passwords and the Default Encryption Password will be permanently lost. This cannot be undone.
settings.about.tagline: Protect your files with real encryption.
settings.about.crypto: Files are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Keys are derived from your password with Argon2id.
settings.about.noRecovery: A forgotten password or master password cannot be recovered, unless you created a recovery key.
settings.about.offline: Works fully offline. No accounts, no analytics and no telemetry.
settings.about.ssd: Removing an original file does not guarantee that its data is unrecoverable on SSDs.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome
onboarding.welcome.body: {app} protects your files with strong, local encryption.
onboarding.welcome.point1: Encrypt files and folders with a password you choose.
onboarding.welcome.point2: Keep related files together in encrypted vaults.
onboarding.welcome.point3: Everything works offline. Nothing leaves your computer.
onboarding.security.title: Create a master password
onboarding.security.body: The master password locks the app and protects your saved passwords.
onboarding.security.unrecoverable: The master password cannot be recovered. If you forget it, your saved passwords are lost.
onboarding.prefs.title: Preferences
onboarding.prefs.body: Choose how the app looks. You can change this later in Settings.
onboarding.prefs.noMaster: Without a master password, the app cannot be locked and passwords cannot be saved.

onboarding.ready.noMaster: You can create a master password at any time in Settings.
onboarding.ready.reminder: Remember your passwords. Without them, protected files cannot be opened.
